draft.subject: A hand getting Clearwater Studio's first project up
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Following up on my note from last week — no pressure, I know getting a new tool going takes time.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
